page.overview:
Who is Ami?

The first time speaks to , he will sigh. When asked what is wrong, explains that while his older brothers get to play all day long, he is forced to stay by the and give directions. Since is the only resident of with a grasp on geography, this job has fallen to him.

On subsequent visits, proclaims that his life is a joke, before he asks what he wants to know about the surrounding area. When asked what is to the east, will explain that is about the only thing in that direction. If asks about the west, mocks and explains is that way. He also shares that he has heard about a hidden escape route from the called the , which was supposedly made for the . To the north, he explains that there is and other things.

When tries to leave, will ask if he wants to know what is to the south. If denies him, says that he will see him around. If agrees, reveals that he wishes he knew but he has never been able to leave . He tells to ask around at if he wants to know.
